article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Balanced hybrid
Genetics: London Jealousy × Jokerz #31
Breeder: Compound Genetics
THC Content: 23–27%
CBD Content: Typically low
Terpene Profile: limonene , beta-caryophyllene , myrcene
Primary Flavors: Sweet citrus, candy gas, creamy Gelato
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–9 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: late September / early October
Indoor Yield: Medium to high
Outdoor Yield: Medium to high
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

UK Riot is built around contrast. One side of the flower can smell bright enough to resemble sweet citrus peel and creamy Gelato, while another layer brings dense candy, earth, funk, and unmistakable fuel. Compound Genetics created that combination by pollinating London Jealousy with reversed Jokerz #31, bringing together a citrus-forward dessert hybrid and one of the breeder’s most important candy-gas selections. The offspring routinely produce green and purple-tinged buds buried beneath trichomes, giving the strain a polished modern appearance before the container has even been opened.

Behind the bag appeal is a practical cannabis plant with an 8–9-week flowering cycle and enough phenotype variation to make selection worthwhile. Compound Genetics found gas throughout the population, but the secondary flavors shifted considerably: some individuals maintained the sweet citrus character of London Jealousy, while others leaned strongly toward the candied Runtz side of Jokerz #31. That combination of consistency and variation gives UK Riot unusual depth. Growers can expect a recognizable family identity without every seed producing an identical expression.
Genetics and Lineage

The official pedigree is London Jealousy × Jokerz #31. London Jealousy itself combines London Pound Cake with Jealousy , placing UK Riot within a dense network of Cookies, Sherbet, Gelato, and fuel-oriented genetics. London Pound Cake contributes sweet dessert characteristics, creamy depth, and substantial flower density, while Jealousy adds another layer of Gelato-family flavor and modern hybrid potency. The particular London Jealousy cut selected for this project stood out for unusual Gelato and citrus notes, which Compound Genetics deliberately sought to preserve in the offspring.

Jokerz #31 supplies the other half of the lineage. Jokerz was originally bred from White Runtz × Jet Fuel Gelato , after which Compound Genetics evaluated approximately 180 plants and retained phenotype #31 as the standout. That clone distinguished itself through purple coloration, dense trichome development, strong structure, smooth smoke, and a terpene profile combining floral perfume, candy, Gelato characteristics, and gas. The cut was subsequently stabilized in tissue culture and tested across multiple environments before becoming a central breeding parent in the Jokerz collection.

Those two families overlap genetically in useful ways without simply duplicating each other. London Jealousy brings sweeter citrus and creamy dessert qualities, whereas Jokerz #31 intensifies candy, Runtz-like sweetness, resin, and fuel. Compound’s own phenotype observations show that the cross can swing toward either direction while maintaining gas as a common foundation. This makes UK Riot especially interesting for growers who enjoy searching seed populations for distinct keepers rather than expecting complete aromatic uniformity from every plant.
Effects and Experience

UK Riot generally opens with a noticeable cerebral lift. The first stage can feel cheerful, mentally expansive, and socially comfortable, with conversation becoming easier and ordinary activities taking on more novelty. Creative tasks, music, gaming, or relaxed gatherings can fit this period well because the mind remains engaged rather than immediately slipping into the sluggish state associated with heavier nighttime weed. The effect is strong, but it usually develops with enough balance to preserve a sense of awareness at moderate doses.

Physical relaxation gradually moves underneath the initial mental brightness. Shoulders and limbs can begin to feel looser as the faster cerebral phase settles into a calmer mood, creating an experience that sits comfortably between stimulation and sedation. Moderate consumption may remain functional enough for an easy evening, while larger servings make the body component considerably more pronounced. The later stages can become slow, hazy, and deeply comfortable without necessarily producing an abrupt knockout.

Potency should still be respected. Compound Genetics does not publish one universal THC figure for every UK Riot phenotype, although commercial examples and breeder-derived listings commonly fall around 23–27%. At that strength, excessive consumption may produce dry mouth, dry eyes, temporary anxiety, dizziness, or difficulty concentrating. Consumers with modest tolerance may find that a smaller serving better showcases the strain’s progression from euphoric mental energy into relaxed physical calm.
Medical Benefits

The balanced nature of the experience may appeal to medical cannabis consumers who want mood elevation without beginning with immediate heaviness. During the earlier stage, the brighter mental shift can make stress, low mood, or general emotional fatigue feel less intrusive. As physical relaxation develops, muscular tension and everyday discomfort may become less prominent, creating a transition that can be useful in the late afternoon or evening when responsibilities are winding down.

Higher doses tilt the experience more strongly toward rest. Appetite may increase, physical stillness becomes more appealing, and the mental pace can slow enough to encourage quiet activities or sleep preparation. That makes UK Riot more flexible than marijuana that remains highly stimulating throughout the entire session. At the same time, the relatively high THC potential means that people sensitive to cannabis-induced anxiety should approach the cultivar cautiously rather than assuming its balanced genetics guarantee a gentle experience.

Chemical composition can differ between phenotypes, so medical effects should not be predicted from the strain name alone. Compound Genetics does not provide a single standardized terpene panel for UK Riot, although the parent lines support the presence of citrus, spicy, floral, herbal, and gas-related compounds. Laboratory information from the actual flower is more valuable for medical use than generalized strain descriptions , particularly when considering cannabinoid strength, medications, tolerance, and individual response.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Sweet citrus is the characteristic that gives UK Riot its clearest separation from many Jokerz hybrids. In London Jealousy-leaning plants, the aroma can resemble citrus candy, orange or lemon peel, and creamy Gelato layered over fuel. The fruit quality is bright rather than syrupy, which gives the flower a sharper top note before the heavier earth and gas become apparent. Compound Genetics specifically highlighted this unusual citrus character when choosing London Jealousy for the project.

Jokerz-dominant phenotypes move toward a different type of sweetness. Candy, Runtz-like fruit, perfume, and dense gas become more pronounced, while the citrus may retreat into the background. Regardless of direction, the breeder observed some fuel in every phenotype examined. Earth and funk underneath the sweeter notes keep the bouquet from becoming purely confectionary and provide a darker base once the flowers are broken apart.

The smoke or vapor can shift again compared with the raw aroma. Citrus and candy are often most noticeable at the beginning, followed by creamy dessert notes, earth, and a lingering gassy finish. Lower-temperature vaporization can preserve more of the brighter fruit and floral compounds, while combustion tends to emphasize funk and fuel. A slow dry followed by a controlled cure is particularly useful because the lighter citrus notes can disappear quickly when freshly harvested weed is exposed to excessive heat or overly rapid moisture loss.
Growing Information

UK Riot is a photoperiod hybrid suited to both indoor and outdoor cultivation. Plants can develop enough vigor to benefit from early canopy management, particularly when the goal is to expose multiple productive branches to direct light. Topping, low-stress training, or a trellis can help create an even structure before flowering begins. Because the finished buds can become extremely resinous and dense, spacing branches properly also improves airflow and reduces stagnant pockets of humidity inside the canopy.

Indoor flowering takes approximately 8–9 weeks. The visual finish is one of the strain’s strongest cultivation traits: green and purple coloration can appear across the population, with flowers becoming heavily coated in trichomes as maturity approaches. Production is generally described as medium to high rather than attached to a fixed breeder weight. Final harvest depends heavily on vegetative time, light intensity, root volume, plant density, nutrition, irrigation, and training. Strong resin development also makes selected plants attractive for rosin, dry sift, and ice-water hash production .

Outdoor gardens need enough favorable weather to complete the same 8–9-week bloom period, placing harvest from late September through October in many Northern Hemisphere environments. Full sunlight and unrestricted roots can considerably increase plant size, although dense flowers require close attention when autumn humidity and rainfall rise. Phenotype hunters may benefit from keeping detailed notes on citrus intensity, candy expression, resin density, flower structure, and finishing speed. The largest plant is not automatically the best keeper; a slightly lower-yielding individual with exceptional citrus-gas terpenes may ultimately offer more value.
FAQ
What strains make UK Riot?

UK Riot was bred by Compound Genetics from London Jealousy × Jokerz #31. London Jealousy combines London Pound Cake and Jealousy, while Jokerz #31 is an elite phenotype selected from White Runtz × Jet Fuel Gelato.
Is UK Riot indica or sativa?

UK Riot is best described as a balanced hybrid. It combines indica- and sativa-derived genetics and tends to produce both cerebral uplift and physical relaxation rather than behaving like an extreme example of either category.
What does UK Riot taste like?

The primary flavors are sweet citrus, creamy Gelato, candy, earth, funk, and gas. London Jealousy-leaning phenotypes can have especially noticeable citrus, while Jokerz-dominant plants may taste more like sweet Runtz-style candy and fuel.
How long does UK Riot take to flower?

Compound Genetics lists an indoor flowering period of approximately 8–9 weeks. Outdoor maturity generally falls between late September and October depending on latitude, climate, and when natural flowering begins.
Is UK Riot a good strain for concentrates?

Its exceptionally heavy trichome coverage makes selected phenotypes promising for rosin, dry sift, and ice-water hash. Resin quantity and quality still differ between plants, so extract-focused growers may want to evaluate several phenotypes before selecting a keeper.
Final Thoughts on UK Riot

UK Riot captures two distinct sides of contemporary marijuana breeding without allowing either to disappear. London Jealousy supplies the unusual sweet citrus and creamy Gelato character, while Jokerz #31 contributes candy, Runtz-like sweetness, fuel, purple coloration, and exceptional resin. The result is a seed line where individual expressions differ, but the central identity remains clear.

For cultivators, an 8–9-week flowering period keeps production practical while green and purple flowers provide considerable visual appeal. Heavy frost adds value for both flower and extraction, and medium-to-high yield potential gives the cultivar more utility than a boutique strain selected strictly for appearance. Growers willing to search several plants can choose between citrus-forward and candy-gas expressions rather than accepting a single fixed phenotype.

The most compelling examples are those where the contrast remains intact: bright citrus against dense gas, creamy sweetness against funk, and an uplifting cerebral start against a gradually relaxing body finish. For cannabis enthusiasts interested in Compound Genetics’ Jokerz family but looking for something beyond straightforward candy gas, UK Riot offers one of the collection’s more distinctive combinations.
